Name: New Girl From Zuzu City Sunday WIP
Author: Podling2112
Description:
PLEASE KEEP IN MIND THIS IS A WIP MOD!!! NEW VERSIONS WILL BE UPLOADED!!!



This is a mod made by me (I'm using my bro's account), and it's a character named Sunday! She is from Zuzu City, and she used to date Pierre in high school. She is sassy and loving. But because I'm a total noob to sprite making and only [i]just[/i] downloaded Paint.Net, her sprites, and portraits are a recolor of Abigail. She felt the easiest to me. And since I downloaded a mod to update the portraits and sprites (Seasonal Cute Characters by Poltergeister) and I used Abigail's [i]original [/i]sprite sheet and portrait sheet, (?) the sprites and portraits are different. So she's [i]TECHNICALLY [/i]not just a straight recolor of Abigail. But enough about her assets, now about the mod itself! I made it using Miss Coriel's Character Creator, and I made the sprites with DIYCP Suite For 1.5. She is dateable and marriable, and some of her easily obtainable favorite gifts are trash (168) and triple espresso (253). Yes, trash. She also loves amethysts, strange dolls, strange buns, prismatic shards, and diamonds. Diamonds are a girl's best friend, after all! I'll see myself out.


So, yeah! As I stated in the overview, recolors, expansions, and translations by other people are only allowed if[i] [/i]you credit me. Other than that, please enjoy! <3
